dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: How long does it take to send a package to Canada?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊ ˈlɔːŋ dʌz ɪt ˈteɪk tə ˈsɛnd ə ˈpækɪdʒ tə ˈkænədə?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: By airmail, it takes about ten days.
dialogue.reading: baɪ ˈɛrmeɪl, ɪt ˈteɪks əˈbaʊt ˈtɛn ˈdeɪz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. How much is the fee?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ˈhaʊ ˈmʌtʃ ɪz ðə ˈfiː?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I need to weigh it first. OK, the fee is nine hundred baht.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈniːd tə ˈweɪ ɪt ˈfɜːrst. oʊˈkeɪ, ðə ˈfiː ɪz ˈnaɪn ˈhʌndrəd ˈbɑːt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Hmm. Is there a cheaper way?
dialogue.reading: ˈhm. ɪz ðɛr ə ˈtʃiːpər ˈweɪ?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: By ship, it's four hundred baht, but it takes two months.
dialogue.reading: baɪ ˈʃɪp, ɪts ˈfɔːr ˈhʌndrəd ˈbɑːt, bʌt ɪt ˈteɪks ˈtuː ˈmʌnθs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That takes too long. I'll send it by airmail.
dialogue.reading: ˈðæt ˈteɪks ˈtuː ˈlɔːŋ. aɪl ˈsɛnd ɪt baɪ ˈɛrmeɪl.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Sure. Here's your tracking number. Please keep it.
dialogue.reading: ˈʃʊr. hɪrz jʊr ˈtrækɪŋ ˌnʌmbər. ˈpliːz ˈkiːp ɪt.
